method: Actual private full-image view of exact prior SE RUN source, NW contact-v01, SE opposite-half-v01 and final horizontal SE opposite-half-v02. Read-only SHA and geometry-status checks. No generation/render/Godot, source edits, guard weakening or image forwarding.

NW_contact_v01.positive_observation: The back-left/NW body and forward upper-left axe extension are actually visible, so forward reach is improved. The body retains red musculature, two swept horns, spiked armor and tail without wings.
NW_contact_v01.blocking_observation: The visible near anatomical LEFT shoulder/upper arm/forearm extends toward screen-left and its hand grips the axe. The farther anatomical RIGHT arm on screen-right terminates in an empty claw. This reverses required RIGHT axe ownership and is directly visible despite the correct reach direction. Geometric success cannot approve it.
NW_contact_v01.decision: Do not select this NW contact pose or mirror it into a completed slot.

SE_opposite_half_v01.semantic_support_observation: All three new poses place SCREEN LEFT/anatomical RIGHT leg low while SCREEN RIGHT/anatomical LEFT knee and foot are high. In the examined prior SE source the exposed low/leading leg reads on SCREEN RIGHT. The new half therefore visibly supplies an opposite anatomical support configuration instead of repeating the prior exposed leg.
SE_opposite_half_v01.hand_and_camera_observation: RIGHT axe grip remains on SCREEN LEFT and the opposite LEFT hand on SCREEN RIGHT stays empty. All three read as front-right/SE; no whole-body mirror or introduced wings was observed.
SE_opposite_half_v01.blocking_observation: Producer strict complete-pose check rejects the vertical sheet because a pose rectangle includes another body and cannot be safely cropped. This review preserves that SOURCE_HOLD and proposes no guard relaxation or partial crop adoption.
SE_opposite_half_v01.decision: Preserve the raw source and positive pose observation, but do not select it for native frames.

SE_opposite_half_v02.semantic_support_observation: The horizontal revision retains the same opposite half: SCREEN LEFT/anatomical RIGHT leg low with SCREEN RIGHT/anatomical LEFT knee/foot high, while RIGHT-hand axe and SE heading stay stable across all three figures. This is a real semantic improvement over the prior low-leg configuration.
SE_opposite_half_v02.identity_observation: Red muscular biped, two black swept horns, spiked dark armor, skull belt/chains, attached tail and axe identity remain readable; no severe whole-body collapse or extra limbs/wings was observed.
SE_opposite_half_v02.blocking_observation: The rightmost third figure extends its empty anatomical LEFT hand/claw to the PNG right edge; outer fingers/claw are visibly truncated there. Producer geometry check independently reports a visible pose touching the image boundary. This is an actual source cutoff, not a contact-sheet viewport artifact.
SE_opposite_half_v02.decision: Do not select the clipped third pose, use a partial workaround, or count this sheet as a complete three-pose replacement.

final_decision: All three authored sources stay preserved but unadopted. NW fails actual handedness; SE-v01 fails complete-pose extraction; SE-v02 retains useful opposite-support semantics but has a visibly clipped final claw. Preserve current r003 and do not claim a new complete SE/NW revision from these failures.
